Logo optional
No logo. The party name block is used instead.

Your parties

Each of your parties is saved as a collection: name, colours, slogan, logo, font and photos of people.

Template parties

Click a party to use it. Untick the ones you don't want: they're hidden from Shuffle and random opponents. With none ticked, Shuffle uses your own parties.

Colours

Anything set to a party colour updates when you change these.

Typeface

Gotham and ABC Sans aren't free web fonts. Montserrat is the closest free match to Gotham. ABC Sans is used if it's installed on this computer; otherwise choose it and upload your licensed files (pick several weights at once). Uploaded fonts last until you close the page.

Add a shape

To put a photo in a shape, select the photo and use Crop to shape.
Click to add points. Click the first point to close.
Drop image to place it

Snapping

Hold Alt while dragging to move freely.

Guides

Drag from a ruler to add a guide. Drag a guide off the poster to delete it.

    Print size and DPI

    DPI only tells a printer how large to print the pixels. It doesn’t add detail. Typing a print size here changes the pixel size to match. For sharp print, aim for 300 DPI up close or 150 DPI for signs read from a distance.
